p: mighty man of power: That is, both valiant and rich.
choice young man: So that it might seem that God approved their request in appointing such a person.
seek the asses: All these circumstances were means to serve God's providence, by which Saul (though not approved by God) was made king.
Zuph: Where was Ramath Zophim, the city of Samuel.
shekel of silver: Which is about five pence, read Ge 23:15.
seer: So called because he foresaw things to come.
sacrifice of the people to day: That is, a feast after the offering, which would be kept in a high place of the city appointed for that use.
bless the sacrifice: That is, give thanks and distribute the meat according to their custom.
save my people out of the: Despite their wickedness, yet God was ever mindful of his inheritance.
heart: Meaning, all that you desire to know.
on whom is all the desire: Whom does Israel desire to be their king, but thee?
upon it: That is, the shoulder with the breast, which the priest had for his family in all peace offerings, Le 10:14
have invited the people: That both by the assembling of the people, and by the meat prepared for you, you might understand that I knew of your coming.
top of the house: To speak with him secretly: for the houses were flat above.
the word of God: God's commandment concerning you.
